reviews.classification: complete discussion workflow and preserved historical audit prompt
reviews.disposition: QW1–QW7 and the question-triage refinement preserve the actual latest user correction, distinguish narrow yes from adjacent proposals, resolve straightforward reversible details and ask only consequential preferences. The at-most-one question ceiling is not an obligation to ask each turn, and ODnumeric order is not mandatory. Exact quotes/owners, point-of-use summary correction and preservation of dated reasoning are useful reconciliation practice; an audit allegation does not broadly retire unrelated direction. The M1–M9discovery method combines inventory/drift/quote mining with journey/stress/retrofit-cost review; reference surveys and external critique need a named uncertainty. Its proposed two-of-four core scoring, pillar draft, W/P/O/Nlabels and seven-section done check remain an historical audit method, not newly binding product rules or evidence the audit was executed now. Old exclusive chat scopes/model delegation/source/commit commands are history; current owner and user authority decide writes. No full north-star/core-audit/source review follows from their listing. The current full-content intake may read large owners in bounded ranges; historical headings-first guidance for a discovery audit does not substitute metadata for this explicitly requested complete review.
reviews.evidence: Actual full249line read through all workflow refinements, original methods, aspect tests and execution/done sections. Listed owners not credited as read.
reviews.reopen: Apply current authority and user scope; use the method only for selected uncertainty, preserve quotes and avoid reopening settled preferences.

reviews.classification: complete interaction palette and later experiments/cross-domain rounds
reviews.disposition: O1–O10, D1–D7, EX1–EX5 and PF1–PF57 preserve real agency through routes, workspaces, tactics, commitments and routines rather than gesture novelty alone. A new surface shares actual command eligibility, cost/custody/knowledge/time and durable publication owners; draft gestures do not grant inputs, knowledge or RNG, while stale targets cannot silently retarget. Property/intent/part/environment/substitution/scale/control/order/support examples need actual consumers, not matching tags as permission lists. Observation, inference, prediction, mastery and useful output stay distinct; imperfect predictions may be wrong, and genuinely superior means can predict exactly. Supported failure can teach or leave useful work without guaranteed XP/refund; genuine repeat training remains allowed. PF24–PF54extend beyond crafting to nonphysical conceptual powers, staged counters, probes, installed aids, return access and ordinary-body/tool variations. No mandatory hygiene/maintenance penalty, concentration tax, NPCengine, universal physics or natural-language resolver is introduced. PF21–PF23/PF55–PF57are later candidates, not an active queue or all-row prerequisite. Four older1366×768targets are historical; current UI_RULES desktop targets supersede them, and the one-realm/prestige milestone was retired by the October24direction. External linked mechanisms are dated documented comparisons, not freshly browsed reference behavior or dependencies selected here. Current crafting-layer work and its writers remain their actual owner; this review dispatches no duplicate workspace prototype.
reviews.evidence: Actual full397line read, including separately recovered complete276–397after output truncation; all table rows and final rule reconciliation read. No current code/prototype/browser or external page verification.
reviews.reopen: Use only relevant palette rows for selected real consumer; current UI targets and actual transaction/support/knowledge owners govern proof.
